e: Russia opens polling stations in Transnistria for the 2026 Russian legislative election.
Vasile Tofan is elected as prime minister by parliament.
Eugen Osmochescu is appointed as acting prime minister.
Alexandru Munteanu resigns as prime minister.
Russia issues a law easing citizenship requirements for citizens of Transnistria.
Two Moldovan nationals held by Belarus are released at the border with Poland following a prisoner exchange facilitated by the United States.
Oligarch Vladimir Plahotniuc is sentenced to 19 years' imprisonment for embezzlement.
President Sandu signs a law withdrawing the country from the Commonwealth of Independent States.

The government declares a 15-day environmental alert in the Dniester River basin after a Russian attack on the Dniester Hydroelectric Station in neighboring Ukraine leads to an oil leakage that threatens water supplies.

Ludmila Vartic dies by suicde after jumping from an apartment block in Chișinău. Her death receives press attention and triggers protests after family members allege that her husband, Party of Action and Solidarity local politician Dumitru Vartic, had subjected her to years of domestic abuse.
A crashed drone believed to have originated from Russia is discovered in Sofia, Drochia District.
A technical malfunction affecting power lines running between Ukraine, Romania and Moldova causes extensive power outages in parts of Moldova, including Chişinău.
A crashed drone believed to have originated from Russia is discovered in Nucăreni, Telenești District.
